source: There are 151 urban areas in the US with no accessible abortion clinics within a 1 hour round-trip drive.
claim: 151 cities have an 8-week round-trip time of at least 1 hour to the nearest clinic.

source: In Boise, patients who are 12 weeks pregnant can make a round-trip journey to a clinic in under an hour. If those same patients try to access care when they are 16 weeks along, their round-trip travel time is nearly nine hours.
claim: Boise City, Idaho has a 12-week round-trip time of 0 hours and a 16-week round-trip time that rounds down to 8 hours.

source: For instance, residents of Meridian, Idaho, who are 20 weeks pregnant would need to make a 10 hour round-trip journey to Utah for services.
claim: Meridian, Idaho has a 20-week round-trip time of 10 hours.

source: Residents of big metropolitan cities, such as New York, Miami, and Seattle, will have access to nearby abortion services regardless of how many weeks pregnant they are.
claim: New York, Miami and Seattle each have a round-trip time of 0 hours at 8, 12, 16 and 20 weeks.

source: But people living in cities such as El Paso, Texas, or Springfield, Missouri, have less access, particularly when they are further along in their pregnancy.
claim: El Paso, Texas has round-trip times of 0 hours at 8 and 12 weeks and 7 hours at 16 and 20 weeks, while Springfield, Missouri has 4 hours at 8 weeks and 5 hours at 12, 16 and 20 weeks.

source: Cities with the longest round-trip travel time in the US.
claim: Rapid City, South Dakota has the longest round-trip time at 8 weeks (9 hours), 12 weeks (9 hours) and 16 weeks (10 hours), and Bismarck, North Dakota has the longest at 20 weeks (11 hours).

source: Change in accessibility at 8 weeks if a clinic in North Dakota closes.
claim: At 8 weeks, closing a clinic in North Dakota raises round-trip times from 2 to 9 hours in Grand Forks, from 5 to 11 hours in Bismarck, and from 0 to 6 hours in Fargo.

source: Change in accessibility at 12 weeks if a clinic in Louisiana closes.
claim: At 12 weeks, closing a clinic in Louisiana raises round-trip times from 0 to 5 hours in Bossier City and Shreveport and from 2 to 3 hours in Longview, Texas.

source: Change in accessibility at 12 weeks if a clinic in Arkansas closes.
claim: At 12 weeks, closing a clinic in Arkansas raises round-trip times from 0 to 4 hours in Little Rock and North Little Rock and from 1 to 4 hours in Conway.

source: Change in accessibility at 16 weeks if a clinic in Utah closes.
claim: At 16 weeks, closing a clinic in Utah raises round-trip times from 1 to 13 hours in Layton and Ogden, from 2 to 13 hours in Logan, and from 0 to 11 hours in Taylorsville and South Jordan.

source: Change in accessibility at 16 weeks if a clinic in Oklahoma closes.
claim: At 16 weeks, closing a clinic in Oklahoma raises round-trip times from 0 to 5 hours in Norman and from 0 to 4 hours in Oklahoma City, Midwest City, Moore and Edmond.
